about: Sound-effect cues of the Blades edition, read by pipeline/mix_blades.py (its docstring explains every field). Every cue is anchored to a shot id of data/blades/plan.json: film time = anchor(shot) + offset, where anchor 'start' is the shot's start (the centre of a whip/zoom/flash/dissolve/matte) and anchor 'frame' is the first picture frame of the shot (where a hard cut is seen). All recordings are Mixkit sound effects, file name = Mixkit id; four long sea recordings are kept as excerpts named <id>_<from>-<to>s.wav, with src_in counted from the start of the excerpt. Licences: /home/user/film/v4/sound/sfx_licences.json. Gains were set by measurement so that the effects stay at least 15 dB under the original mix at every spoken word WITHOUT the automatic gain having to act; after a cut moves, read the warnings mix_blades.py prints.

cues.title: Short fire whoosh
cues.note: flames rise on black: one soft fire whoosh that swells with the fade-in and is already falling when the first syllable comes (0.36 s); nothing else under the spoken intro

cues.title: Fast air woosh
cues.note: air whoosh on the whip into the night crowd; rises 0.3 s and stops just after the centre of the whip

cues.title: Cinematic wind swoosh
cues.note: a different, rounder whoosh on the whip back to the feet

cues.title: Small waves harbor rocks
cues.note: one small real wave: its wash arrives with the foam on the feet (5.7-5.9) and is gone before the quiet word «الأَوالي»

cues.title: Big fire flame burning
cues.note: the pour: a real flame igniting on the flash, then its roar under the molten metal until the punch into the forge

cues.title: Fire swoosh burning
cues.note: fire surge on the zoom punch; its burning tail is cut with the picture at the hourglass

cues.title: Quest game heavy stomp v
cues.note: a short low thump exactly on the hard cut to the hourglass; the voice is silent here, so this is one of the few places a hit can be heard plainly

cues.title: Drum deep impact
cues.note: low soft drum hit on the cut from black to the tethered horse (low-passed at 320 Hz: the body without the stick, and without the drum's 586 Hz overtone); no chain: metal is what was heard as a scream before

cues.title: Quick air woosh
cues.note: third whoosh, a soft one with a longer tail, on the whip into the canter

cues.title: Horse fast gallop in the dirt
cues.note: muffled three-beat hoofbeats on dirt under «وَما يُنجينَ مِن خَبَبِ», fading; low-passed so only the thuds remain; the recording has no whinny or snort (checked)

cues.title: Transition windy swoosh
cues.note: airy swell that rises through the wheeling night sky, peaks on the dissolve into the man (the music accent) and falls away as quiet wind

cues.title: Distant thunder storm explosion
cues.note: distant thunder: only the rolling rumble of the recording (its first clap is skipped, the top is filtered off), starting on the cut to the storm sky

cues.title: Woosh wind
cues.note: one gust of wind that peaks in the middle of the smoke-matte wipe into the dust storm and dies under the line (low-passed: the recording has two faint whistling lines at 4.3 and 6.2 kHz, removed)

cues.title: Sand in the desert
cues.note: grit: real sand hiss riding the gust (gives the low-passed gust its air back from a clean source)

cues.title: Passenger train passing by
cues.note: the rush of a real train arriving (no horn, no brake squeal in this stretch), cut off hard by the clock

cues.title: Tick tock clock close up
cues.note: dry clock tick on the cut to the clock face

cues.title: Tick tock clock close up
cues.note: the tock of the same clock a quarter of a second later, as its light starts to go out; then nothing

cues.title: Short wind swoosh
cues.note: first fly-by as the sparks start to streak

cues.title: Air in a hit
cues.note: second fly-by, a different recording, in the pause after «بِالأَرزاءِ»

cues.title: Cinematic wind swoosh
cues.note: third fly-by in the middle of the same pause: the heart of the wind swoosh used on the second whip, cut short (plain air, no ring)

cues.title: Human single heart beat
cues.note: one slow double heartbeat, low and soft, whose first beat lands on «فُؤادي» over the glowing coal (the recording is a heart's lub-dub, nothing vocal)

cues.title: Breeze through the trees
cues.note: wind in real branches over the thorns; out before the quiet words «مِن نِبالِ»

cues.title: Air woosh
cues.note: the arrows begin as the real sparks start to stream across the man (24.2): a soft rush of air, cut short

cues.title: Arrow whoosh
cues.note: a recorded arrow fly-by (its sub-bass thump filtered off)

cues.title: Fast sword whoosh
cues.note: short fast fly-by, another recording

cues.title: Fast air woosh
cues.note: last fly-by, 0.4 s before the wave so that the cut lands out of a breath of quiet (the tail end of the air whoosh used on the first whip)

cues.title: Sea coast breaking waves
cues.note: THE wave: a real breaker whose attack (7 dB in 20 ms in the recording) lands on the smash cut, in the 0.2 s pause before «تَكَسَّرَتِ»; its body is pulled down quickly so the word is clear

cues.title: Sea waves loop
cues.note: a second, different sea: the surge of another wave on the cut to the blade of rock

cues.title: Deep air woosh
cues.note: soft rush of air for the 0.9 s fall onto the lone rock, under «عَلى النِصالِ»

cues.title: Sea waves on a rocky shore
cues.note: open sea on a rocky shore: a wave arrives as the fall lands (27.8), then the sea sits low under the tail of the music, is left alone for a breath when the music has gone, and fades with the picture
